name: Daia
about: Daia is Febric and Hreda's mother and part of the co-family that shares child-raising with Gladias and Seila. The book does not describe her appearance, so this look is invented and contributors are welcome to replace it.

facts.quote: their co-family, Uncle Vil and Aunt Daia
facts.fact: Co-family with Gladias and Seila; called Aunt Daia.

facts.quote: I'm so excited to see Mom!
Daia caught sight of Gladias approaching. She waved at him.
They cook really good food for us every day.
facts.fact: She and Vil cook for the children.

facts.quote: "How was your time in school been, Zven?", Daia asked.

descriptor: a woman in her mid-forties, short and round-faced, light tan skin, thick black hair streaked with silver piled in a high bun, a warm crinkled smile, wearing a sage-green layered linen wrap dress with a draped crossover bodice and a curved hem, a terracotta knitted half-cape fastened at one shoulder, cream gathered leggings, soft brown seamless clogs and a slim wooden-toned wrist device
